question: Should Commerce make this provider-neutral registration port and identity-bearing StockManagement union its accepted pre-release public contract?
rationale: The branch introduces a public provider API and changes the persisted state union; repository policy reserves product decisions and merges for explicit human approval.

options.title: Approve the bounded contract
options.body: Accept the pre-release API after reviewing a redacted built-runtime transcript and retain the documented no-transport boundary.

options.title: Keep the contract internal
options.body: Defer public exports until the Inventory adapter and upgrade boundary are ready for a stable contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the bounded contract
recommendation.body: Accept the pre-release API after reviewing a redacted built-runtime transcript and retain the documented no-transport boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: The available evidence connects this contributor to the current inventory-provider contract, though confirmation from a repository merge approver is still required.
